technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with short-term momentum (RSI-9, MACD 8/21 crossover) offset by weak trend structure (ADX 10.02), intermediate resistance (EMA 20/50), and lack of volume confirmation in a low-volatility squeeze.

fundamental.summary: TSCO shows weak fundamental signals with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, minimal lobbying engagement, and earnings arriving in 15 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (321+ days old) with only sales and no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (354.56), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring discretionary consumer stocks, NFP event in 2 days, and earnings binary in 15 days create compounded risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 bullish + MACD 8/21 crossover up + supertrend bullish provide short-term momentum entry signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 354.56) with price near support (36.39), offering contrarian risk/reward.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 15 days + NFP event in 2 days + macro crisis (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY) + weak trend structure (ADX 10.02, price below EMA 20/50/200, no volume confirmation) create compounded event risk that overwhelms short-term technicals.
